title: Turn agent feedback and rephrased questions into an evaluation dataset
description: Mine thumbs-down feedback and user rephrases from agent traces, confirm each with one LLM call, and write a deduplicated eval dataset.

title: AI usage and cost attribution across agents, CoWork, Cortex Code, and AI functions
description: One reconciled view of Cortex AI credits by surface, user, agent, model, and cost center, plus budgets and per-user quotas.

title: Size Cortex Code per-user limits from real usage
description: Tiered per-user CoCo quotas, daily limits, and alert-only team budgets, starting from conservative defaults and sized from your own ACCOUNT_USAGE.

title: Diagnose slow Cortex Agent requests from their traces
description: A caller's-rights procedure that reads one agent request's trace, computes a time breakdown by span, and returns an LLM explanation.

title: Causally grounded Cortex Agent that refuses when the data cannot answer
description: A Cortex Agent whose every number comes from a persisted causal estimator, and which declines to answer for cohorts where no honest estimate exists.

title: Agent CI/CD with dbt: per-PR builds, versioned deploys, and an evaluation gate
description: dbt builds the tables and semantic view, the agent ships as a versioned spec from a stage, and an evaluation gate in GitHub Actions blocks promotion.

title: Evaluate and promote Cortex Agent versions
description: Run Cortex Agent evaluations with pinned metric versions and a custom judge, compare two committed versions, and promote the winner by alias.

title: Agent versioning and promotion
description: Commit, alias, promote, A/B route, and roll back Cortex Agent versions with runnable SQL and the behaviors observed along the way.

title: Attach documents to Cortex Agent conversations
description: Let users attach PDFs, Office files, images, and CSVs to a custom agent frontend with a caller's-rights document tool, per-user stage folders, and authenticated middleware.

title: Embedded app context for a Cortex Agent
description: Give an agent embedded in a Streamlit dashboard the page, filters, and persona the user is looking at, by prepending an app-context block to the user message.

title: Multi-agent orchestration with caller's-rights delegation
description: One orchestrator agent delegates to specialist agents through caller's-rights DATA_AGENT_RUN bridges, so Snowflake grants decide which specialist each user reaches.

title: Multi-tenant agents with session attributes and fail-closed policies
description: Serve many tenants from one Cortex Agent: the app server names the end user in an immutable session attribute, and policies derive the tenant from an entitlement.

title: OAuth token passthrough to a Cortex Agent
description: Relay each signed-in user's Entra ID token to a Cortex Agent so the agent runs as that person, with per-user results from a row access policy on CURRENT_USER().

title: Scoping agentic implementations: from 'talk to your data' to a testable agent spec
description: A workshop method for turning a broad agent idea into personas, a question taxonomy, a registered evaluation dataset, and a phased delivery plan.

title: Agentic schema mapping: messy CSVs to canonical tables with a Cortex Agent
description: A Cortex Agent profiles messy CSV files, proposes column mappings with AI_COMPLETE, resolves free-text values, and loads approved mappings through allowlisted SQL.

title: PII redaction with AI_REDACT, AI_COMPLETE extraction, and an entity cache
description: Redact PII in free text with AI_REDACT, cover domain identifiers with AI_COMPLETE structured extraction, and serve redactions from a stream-maintained cache.

title: Cortex AI Gateway governance quickstart
description: Route an app through Cortex AI Gateway with its own identity: both API formats, a model allowlist, traces, per-user cost, and a blocking quota.

title: LangChain agents on Cortex AI Gateway with MCP tools and traces
description: External LangChain agents reason through Cortex AI Gateway, act through a Snowflake MCP server, and are analyzed from gateway traces and per-user cost.

title: Semantic view description quality: a rubric, a linter, and how to apply fixes
description: Grade semantic view descriptions on preciseness, conciseness, non-circularity, and correctness, lint them in SQL, and apply fixes with CREATE OR ALTER or the YAML procedure.

title: Mixed-grain tables: diagnose and fix wrong agent answers with a GRAIN dimension and verified queries
description: An agent double-counts a table that holds daily and monthly rows. Diagnose it from wrong answers, fix the semantic view with a GRAIN enum, rules, and verified queries, re-test.

title: Refine a semantic view from agent logs: triage, SME review, and verified queries
description: Mine Cortex Agent traces for guessed, exploratory, and no-data answers, get the right answer from a subject matter expert, ship it into the semantic view, and re-test.

title: Long-running Cortex Agent runs over managed MCP
description: Split one long MCP tool call into a fast submit and a bounded fetch over background agent runs, so no call nears a client's timeout and caller's rights still apply.

title: Snowflake-managed MCP or the Cortex Agents REST API
description: Decide how people reach a Cortex Agent, with identity and policies in each lane, then best practices for managed MCP servers and the Agents REST API.
